description: Change how clips' media is interpreted (Clip > Modify > Interpret Footage: frame rate, pixel aspect ratio, field order, alpha channel, remove pulldown), set their starting timecode (Clip > Modify > Timecode), or scale them to the sequence frame size (Clip > Video Options > Scale to Frame Size). One undo step

alphaUsage.description: How the alpha channel is interpreted

fieldOrder.description: Field order: default uses the file's own

frameRate.description: Assume this frame rate, frames per second (e.g. 23.976)

items.description: A project item: its id (from list_project_items), its bin path such as "Footage/Interviews/a.mov", or its name when that is unique

name.description: Item name, when only one item has it

path.description: Bin path, "/"-separated, from the project root

pixelAspectRatio.description: Conform to this pixel aspect ratio, e.g. 1 for square pixels or 2 for 2:1 anamorphic

scaleToFrameSize.description: true: scale to the sequence frame size (only true is accepted)

selected.description: Also act on the items selected in the Project panel

name: modify_footage
title: Modify Footage
